program.section_heading: Architecture and Interior Design Digital Production, Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Upon completion of the program, students will demonstrate the ability to communicate designs and projects through drawing, modeling, and collaboration.
Students will develop a portfolio of work displaying a variety of technical skills to apply as an entry level drafter or renderer.

notes: The catalog states 16 units for both the Area of Emphasis and the Required Courses, but the listed courses sum to 17 units (5 x 3 + 2). The printed totals are recorded as stated; a reviewer should check the discrepancy.
ARC 70 in the catalog is matched to closed-list entry 'ARC70' (Portfolio); the state file stores no units for it, and the catalog prints 2.

The program learning outcomes are printed as a running paragraph of two sentences. Each sentence is recorded as one outcome. The opening clause 'Upon completion of the program,' is kept because it is part of the first sentence.

Careers come from the certificate description (design disciplines) and the outcomes (entry level drafter, renderer). The career titles printed under the following ART section belong to another program and are excluded.
The course list at the top of page 92 (ARC 20, ARC 30, ARC 32, ARC 40, etc.) appears to be the tail of a preceding architecture program's section and was not read for this certificate.
